model: L2 logistic regression, penalty 10, fixed; six continuous price features
training: Annual refit; fit data available at previous calendar year start; preceding year validation for threshold; test year strictly later
label_policy: Confirmation+140 by cutoff; negative windows end no later than latest mature pivot of either direction for this scale
alert_policy: One live ledger per task, no year reset; valid seven sessions, rearm after below threshold and expiry; never rescind
score: Continuous global same-direction same-scale one-to-one; unresolved tail PENDING
